question: On which date was the birth anniversary of social reformer Jyotiba Phule observed in the year 2025?
solution: The correct answer is __**11th April**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • **Jyotirao Govindrao Phule**, popularly known as **Mahatma Jyotiba Phule**, was born on **11th April 1827**. • In the year **2025**, his **198th birth anniversary** is observed across the country to honor his contributions to **social justice** and **education**. • He was a prolific **social reformer**, **thinker**, and **writer** from the state of **Maharashtra**, India. • His birth anniversary, celebrated as **Jyotiba Phule Jayanti**, is a significant day for movements advocating the rights of **oppressed classes**, **women**, and **farmers**. • He was one of the earliest pioneers of **women’s education** in India and fought relentlessly against the **caste system** and **untouchability**. ***Hence, the correct option is 11th April.***
